rationale: The visible evidence supports the assertion. Evidence [1] reports CFC-only macro_normalized_regret_at3=0.044697468910847644 and mean_cost_to_contain_winner=13.833333333333334, while LoopCert-style variants have better/lower macro_normalized_regret_at3=0.03223671717595801 but worse/higher mean_cost_to_contain_winner=16.666666666666668. Evidence [2] states the CE gate requires a contender to beat CFC-only on both macro regret@3 and mean cost-to-contain. Evidence [3] records ce_selection_gate_passed=False and gate_verdict=closed. Together these support that LoopCert-style contenders improve regret but fail the cost requirement and that the formal gate remains closed because the configured contenders do not beat CFC-only on both required metrics.
